Touches internal/api/write_budget_test.go, budget_test.go, run_model_cache_test.go, change_show_budget_test.go, watchdog_pollbehind_test.go and the shared helper. fields.statement: Tests that need a file or folder older than the index's 2 s racy window (internal/index/listing.go) backdate its modification time with os.Chtimes through one shared test helper instead of sleeping 2.2 s, so TestReadBudget, TestReadBudgetApply, TestDriverPollIsCheap and the other internal/api tests that slept past the window measure and check the same things without waiting.

set.acceptance: make -n test shows go test with -skip of the budget tests and no -run of them, and no budget phase; make -n test-budgets shows them run -count=1 -p 1 over the packages that hold them; every name in BUDGET_TESTS matches a test that go test -list finds (TestGeneratedModel is dropped or found); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run '^(TestMakeTestTimeout|TestMakeTestShardTargets|TestMakeUpdateDryRun)$' passes with its expected commands updated; .github/workflows/ci.yml's budgets job still runs make test-budgets; failure case: TestMakeTestShardTargets fails when make test's recipe runs a budget test. The make-test-shard-targets capability and AGENTS.md's Commands section no longer say make test runs the budgets. Speedup measure (orchestrator, quiet VM): a warm /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' make test, against 254 s, with no 'Timing budgets' phase in its output. Touches Makefile, cmd/rhiza/makeupdate_test.go, AGENTS.md.
set.statement: The timing budgets are opt-in benchmarks: make test runs the suite with them skipped, and make test-budgets runs them alone, -count=1 -p 1 one package at a time, printing the read-budget timings; CI's budgets job runs make test-budgets on every pull request, so no budget test is lost.

The Makefile has one target per CI job: test-scripts SHARD=i/n (cmd/rhiza's scripts, budgets skipped), test-api SHARD=i/n (internal/api's top-level tests from go test -list, budgets excluded, split round-robin into an anchored -run regex), test-rest (every other package, budgets skipped), test-budgets (the timing budgets alone, -count=1 -p 1, printing the read-budget timings) and lint (fmt-check, vet, self-check); make test and make check run the full suite but the timing budgets, which only make test-budgets runs.
